_comment_team: Set to your assigned team number (1-20) to enable public target validation. Leave null for internal-only use. Team 17: N = 20 + 17 = 37.
_comment_internal_targets: Five fixed server addresses from the packet inventory. Provisional: confirm actual port assignments before enabling service checks.
_comment_public_targets: Team 17 public targets: 172.25.37.10, .15, .20, .100, .120. Exclude core infrastructure (172.31.37.1), shared egress (172.31.37.2), and all other teams' addresses.
_comment_http_checks: Add after confirming endpoints. Example: {"url": "http://172.20.240.10/", "expected_status": 200, "expected_content": "Welcome"}. For IP-scoped HTTPS whose certificate is issued to a virtual-host name, set "sni_hostname": e.g. {"url": "https://172.20.240.10/", "sni_hostname": "gateway.netlab.local", "expected_status": 200}. No credentials in URLs. Redirects are never followed; response bodies are not stored.
